notes.title: Borderless Gaming 1.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Quick patch to address a few issues from 1.0.1.

Changes


Borderless windows created by Borderless Gaming can now be minimized properly

Area selector now handles edge cases better (extreme values, multi-monitor setups)

Improved error handling for startup task creation and efficiency mode


Fixes


Fixed crash when toggling efficiency mode on certain systems

Fixed potential overflow errors when using area selector with large displays



This is a stability patch - no major feature changes.

notes.title: Update Notes for Aug 22, 2024
notes.notes:
We're excited to share that Borderless Gaming and App Containers are now digitally code-signed and verified! This enhancement ensures that our software is secure, and it significantly reduces the chances of false-positive alerts from antivirus programs.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Notes for August 21st, 2024
notes.notes:
In this update, we're happy to announce that while the version of Borderless Gaming itself remains unchanged, we've made significant improvements by updating the App Containers component to version 1.0.2.

Key Highlights:

- App Containers Updated to v1.0.2:
  - We've upgraded the App Containers to version 1.0.2 to address the false positive antivirus reports some users were experiencing. With this update, these false positives should almost all be resolved, ensuring a smoother experience for everyone.

Special Thanks:

A big thank you to our friends at Microsoft for their invaluable assistance in getting the updated Defender definitions pushed out quickly to support this release. Your support helps us maintain a seamless experience for all our users.

---

We appreciate your continued support and look forward to your feedback. As always, happy gaming!

Note: If you continue to experience any issues, please reach out to our support team for assistance.

---

notes.title: Update Notes for v10.0.23
notes.notes:
[center]Update 10.0.23: Potential Startup Issue Mitigation[/center]

Hello everyone,

I've just pushed version 10.0.23 in an effort to potentially mitigate some of the startup issues a few users have been encountering. I appreciate your patience and support as I work to improve your experience with Borderless Gaming.

If you are still experiencing startup issues, I request you to check the Event Viewer on Windows to report any errors Borderless Gaming might be reporting there. Here's a quick guide on how to access the Event Viewer and find relevant error logs:


 Press Windows Key + R to open the Run dialog.
 Type eventvwr and press Enter.
 In the Event Viewer window, expand the Windows Logs section in the left panel.
 Click on Application to view a list of application logs.
 Look for any entries related to Borderless Gaming. Errors are usually marked with a red error icon.
 Double-click on the relevant entry to view detailed information about the error.
 Take note of the error message and any other relevant details.


Please report these details to me to help diagnose and resolve the issue more effectively. Your feedback is invaluable and greatly appreciated.

Thank you for your cooperation and support!

Best regards,
Andrew

notes.title: Update Notes for v10.0.20
notes.notes:
Performance Improvements and Bug Fixes


Improved Process Detection: Implemented a more robust system for detecting and managing processes with windows.

Added timeout mechanism to prevent the application from hanging during process enumeration.
Introduced cancellation support to allow early termination of long-running operations.
Optimized window enumeration to reduce unnecessary processing.


Enhanced UWP Window Handling: Improved the detection and management of Universal Windows Platform (UWP) application windows.

Added specific handling for UWP top-level windows and their child windows.
Implemented safeguards to prevent processing of invalid or inaccessible UWP windows.


Stability Improvements: Added various checks and error handling to improve overall application stability.

Implemented proper error handling for failed window enumerations.
Added checks to prevent processing of invalid window handles.
Improved exception handling throughout the process detection and management system.


Performance Optimization: Made several changes to improve the performance of process and window management.

Reduced unnecessary iterations over processes and windows.
Implemented more efficient data structures for managing window handles.
Optimized the process of checking for hidden and duplicate processes.


Console Output: Added more detailed console output for debugging and monitoring purposes.

Implemented logging for key events such as process updates and timeouts.
Added more informative error messages for troubleshooting.



Known Issues

In rare cases, certain applications may not respond well to borderless mode. Please report any specific issues on our Discord.


Upcoming Features

Improved multi-monitor support
Enhanced customization options for borderless windows
User-defined rules for automatic borderless mode activation


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, please don't hesitate to report them on our Discord.

- Reduced the binary size by 50 MB by using Windows API codegen. 

Speaking of reducing file sizes, I'm happy to announce that I have another project coming to Steam - CompressorX; two years ago I founded an AI research lab to create on-device models for various tasks. One of those models is really good at file compression, and I've rolled it into a new utility that can transparently compress your Steam library, restoring gigabytes of space on your disks, while letting you still play the game.

- Fixes a crash caused by a weird Windows API bug on Russian systems

notes.title: Update Notes for Borderless Gaming v10
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the official release of Borderless Gaming v10 as of today! A huge shoutout to everyone who participated in testing the release candidate. Your support has been invaluable.

What's New? 
In this update, you might notice minimal visual changes. That's because the focus was on enhancing performance and stability from the inside out. Key improvements include:
- Elimination of the .NET Framework dependency for a smoother experience.
- Significant reductions in crashes and stability issues for more reliable gameplay.
- Full compatibility with the latest Windows 11, ensuring everyone can enjoy their favorite games without boundaries.

Migrating Your Settings

Noticed your settings or favorites were reset? No worries! Here's a quick guide to migrate your favorites to v10 seamlessly:
1. Completely exit Borderless Gaming.
2. In your Steam library, right-click on "Borderless Gaming" and select Properties -> Local Files -> Browse.
3. In the installation folder, double-click "bgm.exe" to automatically transfer your favorites.

Need Help?

Encountering issues or have suggestions for our next update? We're all ears!
- Report issues directly on our GitHub page.
- Share your feedback or suggestions for future releases. We're already working on some exciting visual updates for the next version, so stay tuned!

Thank you for being a part of our journey.

notes.title: Patch 9.4.9
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I've just pushed the brand new language update for Borderless Gaming. This update will enable anyone to easily translate the software into a different language with no coding knowledge required! 

So if you've ever wanted to translate Borderless Gaming into your native language, now is the chance. You can find a detailed tutorial  here.

Other than that a few bugs have been fixed such as


 Fixed bug that would not let you restore hidden applications
 Fixed bug that was not setting the favorite screen
 Improved UI for favorites
 Mute in Background should no longer crash the application.
 Fixed bug that randomly reset favorites.
 Fixed a rare crash.

notes.title: Patch 9.4.7
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

In the continued effort to rewrite Borderless Gamings core code, I've pushed out a brand new update that improves performance of the application. Response times should now feel a lot smoother and CPU usage should be down.

Here is a full list of changes 

 New portable config file, favorites and settings saved to a single file on disk rather than registry. (All favorites/settings have been reset)
 Borderless Gaming can now mute/unmute games depending on their focus. Great for mult-tasking/streaming.
 Fixed multiple crashes.
 Improved resource usage. 
 Switched build to use highest, so users without administration privileges should still be able to launch.

Because this required a lot of changes to the core code, please report any issues you find on the forums.

notes.title: 8.4 Release
notes.notes:
What’s included in this update?

Swapped the Aurora Group copyright text and image from the About menu and replaces it with Codeusa Software again.Fixed a minor menu issue with the Favorites list right-click showing checkmarks at odd offsets.Added a statusbar label hint for right-clicking since it’s not obvious you can do that and wasn’t present in pre-6.5 versions.Added a menu option to the Help menu that links to the ‘How to use’ guide at the Steam discussion board.Updated the source code solution and installer to multiple projects that compile to different binaries with individual projects overlapping source files wherever possible.  This will make it easier to deploy Steam versions.
